agyos_skill.intent: Pitch Coach. Rehearses the investor call with you: drills the hard questions investors ask (market, competition, traction, unit economics, team, why now, risks, the ask), tailored to your own numbers from the competitor scout, the financial model, the market size and the investor you are meeting (\
